description: The collection supplies 50,000 simulated contamination scenarios across L-TOWN, Modena and Zhi Jiang. MATLAB v7.3 files hold hourly sensor readings and event labels for a 14-day simulation, generated using EPANET-MSX. This resource is provided by Chen, Xiaohan; Vrachimis, Stelios; Polycarpou, Marios. Coverage is global as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists TAR formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The provider text mixes arsenic injection and chlorine readings. Preserve that distinction and check variables before reuse; simulations are not field contamination records. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
